# VESA Display Monitor Timings, the progressive modes.
# Columns: DMT ID (hex), width, height, nominal rate in Hz, pixel clock in
# kHz, horizontal front porch, sync and back porch in pixels, vertical
# front porch, sync and back porch in lines, sync polarity (H then V, p
# positive, n negative), and where the timing comes from: d the DMT's
# own, c CVT standard blanking, r CVT reduced blanking, 2 CVT reduced
# blanking version 2. Borders, which a few old DMT modes list apart, are
# folded into the porches beside them.
#
# Source: VESA Display Monitor Timing Standard, version 1.0 revision 13.
# Transcribed by hand without a copy of the standard at hand. The c, r
# and 2 rows are checked by modes_proofs against this crate's own CVT
# 1.2 arithmetic, which must give every number on the row; the d rows
# are checked only for a rate within half a percent of the nominal one
# and must be compared line by line against the standard before relying
# on them. The interlaced DMT modes (IDs 0F, 1024x768 at 43 Hz) and the
# 59.94 Hz variant of 57 are not listed.
